phase: Phase 22: Mesh Airtime QoS Traffic Shaping & Airtime Contention Mitigator

stories.title: Pure KMP Mesh Priority QoS Traffic Scheduler & Preemption Arbiter
stories.description: Implement QoSModels.kt, MeshQoSQueue.kt, and MeshQoSScheduler.kt in app/sharedLogic/src/commonMain/kotlin/org/nowni/intercom_alpha/mesh/qos/. Implements a thread-safe, 4-tier strict priority packet queue (EMERGENCY_CRITICAL, ACTIVE_VOICE, ROUTING_CONTROL, BULK_TELEMETRY). Guarantees starvation prevention via deficit round-robin tokens for control packets, unconditional preemption of bulk data during active voice streams, and airtime duty-cycle pacing. 100% pure Kotlin with 0 Java/C dependencies (Rules 2 & 3).
acceptanceCriteria: Pure KMP implementation with zero Java, C, or platform-specific dependencies in commonMain (Rules 2 & 3)
Defines QoSPriority tiers (EMERGENCY_CRITICAL, ACTIVE_VOICE, ROUTING_CONTROL, BULK_TELEMETRY)
Unconditionally preempts low-priority telemetry/file packets when voice or emergency SOS frames arrive
Provides starvation protection ensuring routing control packets are serviced within bounded delay
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: MeshTransport Wire Integration & Bulk File Airtime Throttling
stories.description: Integrate MeshQoSScheduler into MeshTransport.kt and MeshFileTransferManager.kt. Wraps outbound BLE GATT write operations through the scheduler. Automatically throttles background GPX/GeoJSON trail file transmission to a low duty cycle (<=10% airtime) whenever voice packets or emergency frames are detected, eliminating 2.4GHz RF packet collisions and buffer bloat during active conversation.
acceptanceCriteria: All outbound mesh packets route through MeshQoSScheduler based on packet type and priority
File chunk beaming automatically throttles during active PTT voice transmission
Zero dropped voice packets caused by concurrent file transfer contention
100% unit test pass across JVM, Android, and iOS Simulator targets

stories.title: Subsystem Hardware Bridge Wiring & Multiplatform Tactical QoS HUD Presentation
stories.description: Wire MeshQoSScheduler into IntercomHardwareBridge, AndroidPlatformBridge, and IntercomBridge (iosMain) with typed CancellationHandle observers. Expose reactive QoSSnapshot (active queue depths, dropped packet stats, voice preemption counter, airtime utilization percentage). Present QoS link health badge and channel congestion warning sheet in Compose Multiplatform (HomeScreen.kt) and 100% Native iOS SwiftUI (ContentView.swift / IntercomViewModel.swift respecting Rule 1).
acceptanceCriteria: Hardware bridges expose QoSSnapshot flow and reactive CancellationHandle observers for iOS (Rule 1)
Compose Multiplatform displays tactical QoS airtime pill and congestion alert banner
100% Native iOS SwiftUI displays tactical QoS indicator in TacticalAvionicsBar (Rule 1)
Full compilation and automated verification pass across all targets

stories.title: 32-Node Congested RF Mesh QoS Simulation Harness & Archify Showcase Update
stories.description: Implement CongestedMeshQoSSimulationHarness.kt simulating a 32-node large convoy under 40% RF contention and concurrent OTA route beaming. Validates that QoS voice preemption and airtime throttling maintain >92% voice packet delivery ratio and <120ms latency despite heavy background file transfers. Update Archify interactive architecture specifications to showcase quality.
acceptanceCriteria: Simulates 32 nodes under heavy RF contention and background data transfers
Validates voice preemption over background GPX telemetry with zero voice starvation
Demonstrates airtime throttling maintaining voice PDR > 92%
Archify architecture specification and HTML showcase updated with 9/9 verification pass
Full multiplatform test suite pass across all targets
